messages:
Maria: CI red on main after a toolchain image bump. Lots of targets failing at the shared link step. Job: https://ci.redwood.dev/teams/infra/builds/987654 — anyone seen this? :eyes:

Chris: which targets are failing? can you paste the short linker error?

Maria: top failure snippet from the job:
```
/path/to/toolchain/bin/x86_64-redwood-linux-ld: services/liblogging.so: undefined reference to `pthread_create@GLIBC_2.2.5'
/path/to/toolchain/bin/x86_64-redwood-linux-ld: services/liblogging.so: error: undefined reference to symbol 'pthread_join@GLIBC_2.2.5'
//usr/lib64/libpthread.so.0: error: undefined symbol: pthread_create
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status

(see full log at the CI link)
```

Alex: looks like link flags are missing (-lpthread) or the toolchain packaging changed. we had a similar ccache split-link oddity in the last roll where some linkopts were dropped.

Maria: bazel is invoked by CI as: `bazel build //services/... --config=linux-x64 --compilation_mode=opt`. We rolled toolchain from `gcc11-2025-11-20` to `gcc12-2026-03-10` yesterday.

Chris: try `bazel build //services/logging:liblogging --sandbox_debug --spawn_strategy=local` locally and see if it reproduces. if it passes locally but fails in CI, sandbox/ccache environment probably to blame.

Maria: running locally now... reproduces with same undefined reference.

Diane: I can take a look — the GLIBC symbol versioning in the error suggests a lib mismatch. which base image did we roll to exactly?

Maria: image tag is `redwood/toolchain:gcc12-2026-03-10`. previous tag was `redwood/toolchain:gcc11-2025-11-20`.

Alex: quick triage checklist: 1) try reverting toolchain image in CI to previous tag; 2) attempt a targeted build adding `--linkopt=-lpthread` to see if it bypasses; 3) run `readelf -d` on the produced .so to inspect NEEDED entries.

Chris: can someone bisect the toolchain image layers? maybe an asset got dropped in the packaging step. @eng-infra-oncall might have rollback perms.

Maria: kicked off a rerun with the rollback tag (job 987655). pinging @eng-infra-oncall for rollback if rerun still fails.

oncall-bot: Notifying eng-infra-oncall: build rerun requested by Maria — job 987655. Please take action if still failing.

Alex: also FYI, if CI uses ccache for object caching, split-link behavior can sometimes drop link args when objects are merged—try disabling ccache with `CCACHE_DISABLE=1` in the CI job as an experiment.

Maria: rerun finished — job 987655 passed after rolling back the image. So confirmed the gcc12 image introduced the break. We'll keep the rollback until we investigate. :thumbsup: 

Chris: filing a follow-up issue for toolchain image validation and pre-roll checks. assigning investigation to @Alex and @Diane. Please include reproduction steps and a diff of packaging.

Diane: noted. I'll diff the image packaging and check glibc/ld.so versions, and report back with findings and a proposed fix. starting now.
